svg.aria-label: AWS EC2 infrastructure provisioned with Terraform: VPC, security groups, IAM roles and EC2 instances.

g.text: terraform destroy / apply: rebuild from code
Terraform configs that provision EC2 instances, VPC networking, IAM roles and security groups, so
the whole environment can be torn down and rebuilt from code instead of clicked together by hand.
Reusable templates stay consistent across dev and prod.
